_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil with breaker already on tape (ETF demand near zero, crowded longs) favors a one-rung slip into Denial rather than hold or climb.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forwards Denial/DOWN low conviction; narrative supplies flow color only and does not confirm the forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC loses the range with funding flipping negative, VIX elevated, and ETF flows stuck near zero
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound and CVD recovers while price holds, lifting fear/greed through 60 toward Complacency
